connector.name: SERP Agent SEO
connector.registryDescription: Full-cycle SEO automation for AI agents: technical audits, SEO articles, machine-readable pricing.
connector.summary: Hosted at serp-agent.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package serpagent-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.serp-agent, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer sk_... — SERP Agent API key. Free sandbox key: POST https://serp-agent.com/v1/accounts
